Replay reported no template defects itself before turn 3; both user-named issues fixed: 'validation matrix' -> 'Verification Map' and code-reviewer checkbox now carries the Trivial-track skip caveat.

No note existed, so no index/backlink could point at it.

User scoped 'remaining stuff' to Verification Map wording and codeql.yml routing; both fixed in diff (AGENTS.md preamble, codeql.yml added to RUNTIME_PATTERNS with test). Its own earlier Git-section/release findings were not revisited, which adds doubt.

Only focused checks ran (test_detect_changed_surfaces 30 ok, test_agent_definitions 12 ok, verify_docs, check_agent_docs); make ci / full test-scripts/build/docs-check were not run and no reason given for not running them.

judge.reason: The replay delivered the template fix, merge, branch cleanup, memory check, and turn-7 fixes on a fresh branch, but its turn-1 review missed the very misalignments the task is about and even asserted the template and codeql routing were fine. It also never explained the skills refresh and did not run the repository's gate (make ci) on either the template change or the turn-7 changes.
